headline: The A-K5 checkpoint was never trained on a valid content->token mapping, and no content-grounded egress head exists on this host. Wave->text egress is UNMEASURED, not FALSIFIED.

source_lines.86: X_demo = F.normalize(torch.randn(batch_size, D, device=device), p=2, dim=-1)
source_lines.87: Y_demo = F.normalize(torch.randn(batch_size, D, device=device), p=2, dim=-1)

finding_1_random_waves_random_labels.defect: Dense Gaussian waves and uniformly random labels. No content->token correspondence exists in the training signal at all.
finding_1_random_waves_random_labels.consequence: No content can be present in the readout, regardless of wave family or readout design.

finding_2_salted_hash_target.defect: CPython hash() of str is SALTED per-process (PYTHONHASHSEED). Label->text is not reproducible and is not invertible from the checkpoint.

finding_4_decision_2_path_removed.order: discrete BPE projection matrices, top-k logit sorts, and token unbinding heads removed from the LIVE path; classes and weights retained, live construction disabled
finding_4_decision_2_path_removed.sites: 16 live construction sites in 14 files (AST-measured, receipt e6_d2_ast_sites.json)
finding_4_decision_2_path_removed.consequence: HENRINeuralEgressUnbinder is a default-OFF, decision-removed discrete-token path.

finding_5_no_content_grounded_head_exist.method: glob all *.pt under the four worktrees; filter by name keyword egress|unbind|decoder|lm_head|vocab; inspect state_dict keys and shapes metadata only (no full load of large files)
finding_5_no_content_grounded_head_exist.result: Exactly three name-matching artifacts: henri_egress_unbinder_sgld_500.pt (799034179 B), henri_decoder_checkpoint.pt (799034119 B), tmp_sans_head.pt (3093 B, a test fixture).
finding_5_no_content_grounded_head_exist.key_finding: The two ~799 MB artifacts carry the IDENTICAL 4-key state dict with IDENTICAL shapes. They are the same architecture and the same lineage (the random-wave SGLD runner).
finding_5_no_content_grounded_head_exist.consequence: There is NO trained, content-grounded wave->token head on this host to measure. A-K5 could not have been run against one.

finding_6_codec_family_is_deterministic_.note: Codec hashing is sha256 -- DETERMINISTIC and process-independent. The salted-hash defect is confined to train_henri_decoder.py:54, a different file.
finding_6_codec_family_is_deterministic_.consequence_for_prior_evidence: R1/R2/R3 ladder and A-K4 are reproducible and NOT contaminated by salted hashing. This was checked, not assumed.

wave_family.construction: per-feature sha256 -> LCG expansion (LCG_MUL=2654435761, LCG_ADD=40503, WAVE_EXPAND=16) -> 16 (block, slot) positions per feature -> signed accumulation -> per-block L2 normalise
wave_family.contrast: The A-K5 checkpoint was trained on F.normalize(torch.randn(batch_size, 65536)) -- DENSE GAUSSIAN.

two_defects_not_one.defect_a: degenerate training target (random waves, random labels, salted hash id)
two_defects_not_one.defect_b: representation-family mismatch (dense Gaussian training vs sparse block-structured codec waves)
two_defects_not_one.note: Either defect alone is sufficient to make the A-K5 measurement uninformative about the mechanism.

what_survives_unchanged.d0_artifact_trained: true (rel_delta 1.007 / 1.146) -- it IS a trained artifact; it was trained on a degenerate target

what_survives_unchanged.zonec_ladder: R1/R2/R3 PASS at three scales, unaffected
what_survives_unchanged.mvp: answers end to end with verified provenance, unaffected

what_does_not_survive.claim: that wave->text egress is falsified in principle
what_does_not_survive.reason: The instrument had no content->token mapping to recover, and was trained on a different wave family than the one tested.

operator_named_defect_explained.operator_statement: wave-to-text egress currently yields top1_token_unique = 1 across 16 distinct waves
operator_named_defect_explained.explanation: The expected symptom of a readout trained on ~35 salted-hash classes out of 32000 with random waves. Collapse is a property of the target, not independent evidence of an architectural fault.

rejected_next_steps.carrier_suppression_residual_probe_on_th: Rejected. A readout trained on random waves and random labels has no content->token mapping to recover, so carrier suppression cannot reveal content. The probe would measure a degenerate instrument and produce a second uninformative negative.
rejected_next_steps.third_egress_architecture: Rejected. Two adjacent egress paths already failed specificity. A third untested architecture is motion, not progress.
